title: Artificial intelligence in cancer: applications, challenges, and future perspectives

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in cancer: applications, challenges, and future perspectives》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly revolutionizing the landscape of oncological research and the advancement of personalized clinical interventions.

evidence.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly revolutionizing the landscape of oncological research and the advancement of personalized clinical interventions.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in cancer: applications, challenges, and future perspectives》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Progress in three interconnected areas, including the development of methods and algorithms for training AI models, the evolution of specialized computing hardware, and increased access to large volumes of cancer data such as imaging, genomics, and clinical information, has converged, leading to promising new applications of AI in cancer research.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】AI applications are systematically organized according to specific cancer types and clinical domains, encompassing the elucidation and prediction of biological mechanisms, the identification and utilization of patterns within clinical data to improve patient outcomes, and the unraveling of the complexities inherent in epidemiological, behavioral, and real-world datasets.

AI applications are systematically organized according to specific cancer types and clinical domains, encompassing the elucidation and prediction of biological mechanisms, the identification and utilization of patterns within clinical data to improve patient outcomes, and the unraveling of the complexities inherent in epidemiological, behavioral, and real-world datasets.
